text:
sqlpipe is a command-line tool that copies Postgres tables to Amazon S3 as Parquet files. It reads rows from one or more tables, converts them to Parquet format, and uploads the results to a target bucket. You can run it as a one-time command or on a recurring schedule.

sqlpipe supports full and incremental syncs. A full sync copies all rows from a table. An incremental sync copies only the rows that changed after the last run. The tool manages type conversion, partitioning, and compression. You control all behavior through a single YAML file. Each run logs its progress to standard output, so you can monitor long transfers or send the output to a log collector.
